t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes are in 2 different groups.Red, blue, pink, purple is one group.Brown, green, yellow, orange are another group.One group of gnomes will give you more points than the other when the multiplier is between x1 and x3, but sometimes it will give you 0.x5 multiplier the gnome group selection seems to be more random

vb_textbox.text: Each selection will give you between 0 and 9 mushrooms plus the multiplier. There are 2 groups of gnomes that will appear. Pink, Purple, Red and Blue are one group and Green, Brown, Yellow and Orange are the other. One group will usually give you a higher amount of mushrooms than the other (5 or more) and one group will usually give you less (4 or less). I found that the group that gave you more mushrooms changed over the course of the game, so I consistently chose gnomes from the same group until one gave me less mushrooms and then I would switch to the other group.
